 Liverpool midfielder starts after missing last three games through injury
 Liverpool have been handed a timely boost ahead of important clash.
 by Harry Vidgen 01.11.2026 Add to Preferred Sources Follow DaveOCKOP: Add us as a preferred source on Google.
 It is a big weekend for Liverpool, with the club looking to pick up three points and give everyone around the club another reason to feel positive.
 With plenty of football still to be played this season, every result matters, and a win today could go a long way towards lifting morale and building some momentum.
 Liverpool have now confirmed their starting XI for their latest fixture , with one welcome return to the side after an injury lay-off.
 Sam Kerr is back in the starting XI for Liverpool Women as they prepare to face West Ham United in the Barclays Women’s Super League this afternoon.
 The Scotland international has missed the Reds’ last three matches through injury but has recovered in time to return to the line-up.
 Kerr replaces Vivien Endemann in the only change made by Liverpool from the side that drew with London City Lionesses last weekend.
 It is a welcome boost for the Reds, who will be hoping her return can help them get back to winning ways after a difficult spell recently.
 The start of the season began positively for the women’s team, but their efforts have faded as the season has developed.
 A win against West Ham United today is a necessity.
 Liverpool kick off at 2pm GMT at Chigwell Construction Stadium, with the match available to watch live on the official WSL YouTube channel.
 Liverpool XI: Keating, Kerr, Clark, Fisk, Bernabe, Nagano, Maclean, Ramos, Bergstrom, Kapocs, Olsson.
 Substitutes: Kirby, Parry, Endemann, Enderby, Höbinger, Agrez, Itamura, Ward, Trueman.
